# SOAP2 2.19 executables

This directory contains the Linux x86_64 `soap` and `2bwt-builder` executables used by the host-SNP workflow. Their SHA256 values are recorded in `SHA256SUMS.txt` and are checked by `../../scripts/install_soap2.sh` before installation into the active `i2bRAD-M` environment.

SOAP2 is third-party software and remains subject to the terms of its original authors and distributors. See `../../THIRD_PARTY.md` for the repository-level notice.
